adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, the new `teamDestinationCalendars` array is populated via a side effect inside the `users.slice(1).map(async (user) => { ... })` that primarily builds attendee/team-member objects and translations (`getTranslation(...)`). Specifically, the callback does `teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar)` when `isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE"`. This couples calendar-selection data collection to attendee/translation mapping, making the logic harder to reason about and maintain. It’s diff-grounded and actionable, but not a clearly verifiable functional defect on its own (the push occurs before the first `await`, so it won’t be racey here).
